resources.name: IntraMaps API
resources.description:
IntraMaps API: one request for each route, each with a short test.

Run:
1. python helpers/load_demo.py
2. uvicorn intramaps.main:app
3. In Insomnia 10 or newer, import this file, open the collection, click "Run Collection" and then "Run".

The requests run top to bottom and share the token saved by Login. The run creates one user and deletes it in the last request, so it can be repeated (Login appears twice because Logout ends the first session). If the API is not at http://127.0.0.1:8000, change "host" in the environment.
